description: Mandy Newton Rosenow is a Democrat candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives serving the 46th District in the 2026 elections. Mandy will fight for public education, accessible health care, reducing the cost of living in Iowa, and addressing the alarmingly high cancer rates in this state.
